purpose: A salaried customer in a dual-income family whose easy-access savings cover only about two and a half months of essential spending, against a six-month emergency target. All the information is complete, so the analysis runs end to end and the existing emergency-fund rule steers it to a savings-first recommendation instead of an investment portfolio. The inputs cause that behaviour; nothing here states it. Primary member of the family household.

risk_data_link.note: an anonymised FAR-Trans customer with 14 months of trading history; the risk model decides the category
